entries.title: Settings says how task classification helps you
entries.body: In Settings, under Decisions, the Task classification row now says what you gain from it: each new task runs on a model that fits the work, so easy tasks spend less of your plan's allowance. The row reads this way in every language Infinitary speaks.
entries.noPicture: Only the one line of words under a Settings row changes, and this note quotes it.
